description: This file contains a localization (i18n) module for the Select2 plugin, providing Azerbaijani translations for various UI messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters to delete in Azerbaijani.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters to enter in Azerbaijani.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
